name: UnitStackConfigurationDTO
description: UnitStackConfigurationDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

beginDate.description: Date in which information became effective or activity started.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective or date in which activity ended. This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring configuration record.

unitRecordId.description: Unique identifier of a unit record which is generated by the EPA Host System.

stackPipeRecordId.description: Unique identifier of a stack or pipe record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
